body:
This issue needs clarification before autonomous execution:

1. This ticket declares a hard dependency on #49 (`.starterpack/config.yaml` must exist first), but #49 has not merged yet (PR #55 is still open). Should autonomous processing of this ticket wait until #49 merges to main, or should work begin on a branch that builds on top of the `FEAT/49-add-config-yaml-schema` branch?

This issue is labeled autonomously-nightly but cannot proceed without answers to the above.
Once resolved, re-run the nightly workflow or remove the label and work on it manually.
